title: A counterexample to a conjecture of Thakur on Carlitz-Wieferich primes
summary: Let A = F_q[T] with q a power of an odd prime p, let [n] = T^(q^n) - T, and let rho be the Carlitz module. A monic prime P of A is a c-Wieferich prime (to base 1) if rho_P(1) = 1 mod P^2. Thakur suggested in 2015, on the basis of limited data and of proofs in degrees 2 and 3, that in odd characteristic every c-Wieferich prime has degree divisible by p; the question was restated as open in 2024, and Bamunoba and Bergstrom, after extensive computations, expressed the belief that the statement holds in odd characteristic.
